_source: cad/clock_plate.svg, 1 SVG unit = 0.264583 mm (110.26456 mm / 416.748 units)
_angles: degrees, 0 = 12 o'clock, clockwise positive. The homing index sits at 0.

dial._opening_note: README §3. Not drawn in clock_plate.svg -- the SVG has the plate outline and the cutouts only.

ticks._note: The CAD has 12 rectangular batons, not the 12 dots README §3 and CLAUDE.md describe.

homing._note: Both hands sweep over this radius; the hour hand is 25 mm, so it just covers it.

hands._note: The 40 mm minute hand reaches into the baton band (35.14-40.85 mm).

status_leds._y_note: Below the dial centre. Provisional: the LED holes are in README §3/§9 but not yet in the CAD.
status_leds._icons_note: Lucide names, as etched on the plate (README §3).
status_leds._labels_note: What fits under an 11 mm pitch; matches the firmware's px_names.
